story.title: The Little Door

panels.desc: Behind an old wooden school garden shed, a brave little white rabbit in green rain boots and a careful little hedgehog crouch in the grass, discovering a tiny round wooden door at the base of the shed wall, half hidden by ivy. Afternoon light, butterflies.

lines.text: Bun and Hedgie find a little door.

panels.ko: 번이 담쟁이를 걷자 창고 벽 아래 작은 둥근 문이 나왔어요. 헤지는 조심조심 들여다봐요.

panels.desc: Through the open little door: a magical sunny garden with a long winding row of twenty-six empty clay flower pots and a tiny round yellow baby bird with a green leaf scarf sitting sadly on a pot with its beak closed and a single tear. The rabbit and the hedgehog peek in from the doorway, amazed.

lines.text: This is Pip. Pip cannot sing.
lines.ko: 얘는 핍이에요. 핍은 노래를 못 해요.

panels.ko: 문 너머에 빈 화분이 줄지어 있어요. 첫 화분 위에서 핍이 눈물을 흘려요. 핍은 노래를 못 해요.

story.synopsis_ko: 번과 헤지가 학교 창고 뒤에서 작은 문을 찾았어요. 문 너머는 소리 정원! 빈 화분 스물여섯 개와 노래를 잃은 아기 새 핍이 있었어요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the tiny round door slowly creaks open and warm golden light spills out through the ivy; the rabbit and the hedgehog look at each other with wide excited eyes; butterflies flutter. Camera still. Soft, child-friendly. No text.

pages.desc: Behind an old wooden school garden shed on a sunny afternoon. Bun, the small white rabbit in green rain boots, pushes a curtain of ivy aside with both paws and finds a tiny round wooden door at the base of the shed wall. Hedgie, the small hedgehog with a flower in his spikes, peeks nervously from behind a watering can. Butterflies, dandelions. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.text: Bun and Hedgie find a door.

pages.ko: 창고 뒤에서 번이 담쟁이를 걷고 작은 둥근 문을 찾았어요. 헤지는 물뿌리개 뒤에서 빼꼼 내다봐요.

pages.desc: Through the open little door: the Sound Garden, a magical sunny garden with a long winding row of twenty-six empty clay flower pots, pink blossoms, a pond glinting in the distance and a wooden fence at the far end. Pip, a tiny round yellow baby bird with a green leaf scarf, sits sadly on the first pot with its beak closed and a single tear. Bun and Hedgie stand in the doorway, amazed. Far away on a dark little hill, only a tiny spark of lantern light is visible; Grumble himself is hidden.

lines.text: This is Pip. Pip cannot sing.
lines.ko: 얘는 핍이에요. 핍은 노래를 못 해요.

lines.text: Shh... Who is on the hill?

pages.ko: 문 너머는 소리 정원이에요. 빈 화분 스물여섯 개, 첫 화분 위에 눈물 흘리는 핍. 먼 언덕에 작은 불빛이 보여요.
